rows.note: Use 椰菜 as the all-purpose word for the cabbage plant and its leaves eaten as a vegetable.

example.english: I bought some cabbage to stir-fry.
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 di1 je4 coi3 faan1 lei4 caau2

rows.note: Use 植物人 for someone in a medically recognized vegetative state, rather than for every person with brain damage.

example.english: The doctor said Ming is in a vegetative state and even needs to be fed cabbage.
example.traditional: 醫生話阿明已經係植物人，連食椰菜都要人餵。
example.jyutping: ji1 saang1 waa6 aa3 ming4 ji5 ging1 hai6 zik6 mat6 jan4 lin4 sik6 je4 coi3 dou1 jiu3 jan4 wai3
